translation: The Clear Quran — Dr. Mustafa Khattab

verses.37:1: By those ˹angels˺ lined up in ranks
verses.37:2: and those who diligently drive ˹the clouds˺
verses.37:3: and those who recite the Reminder
verses.37:5: ˹He is˺ the Lord of the heavens and the earth and everything in between, and the Lord of all points of sunrise
verses.37:6: Indeed, We have adorned the lowest heaven with the stars for decoration
verses.37:7: and ˹for˺ protection from every rebellious devil
verses.37:8: They cannot listen to the highest assembly ˹of angels˺ for they are pelted from every side
verses.37:9: ˹fiercely˺ driven away. And they will suffer an everlasting torment
verses.37:10: But whoever manages to stealthily eavesdrop is ˹instantly˺ pursued by a piercing flare
verses.37:11: So ask them ˹O Prophet˺, which is harder to create: them or other marvels of Our creation? Indeed, We created them from a sticky clay
verses.37:12: In fact, you are astonished ˹by their denial˺, while they ridicule ˹you˺
verses.37:13: When they are reminded, they are never mindful
verses.37:14: And whenever they see a sign, they make fun of it
verses.37:15: saying, “This is nothing but pure magic
verses.37:16: When we are dead and reduced to dust and bones, will we really be resurrected
verses.37:18: Say, “Yes! And you will be fully humbled.”
verses.37:19: It will only take one Blast, then at once they will see ˹it all˺
verses.37:20: They will cry, “Oh, woe to us! This is the Day of Judgment!”
verses.37:21: ˹They will be told,˺ “This is the Day of ˹Final˺ Decision which you used to deny.”
verses.37:22: ˹Allah will say to the angels,˺ “Gather ˹all˺ the wrongdoers along with their peers, and whatever they used to worship
verses.37:23: instead of Allah, then lead them ˹all˺ to the path of Hell
verses.37:24: And detain them, for they must be questioned.”
verses.37:25: ˹Then they will be asked,˺ “What is the matter with you that you can no longer help each other?”
verses.37:26: In fact, on that Day they will be ˹fully˺ submissive
verses.37:27: They will turn on each other, throwing blame
verses.37:28: The misled will say, “It was you who deluded us away from what is right.”
verses.37:29: The misleaders will reply, “No! You disbelieved on your own
verses.37:30: We had no authority over you. In fact, you yourselves were a transgressing people
verses.37:31: The decree of our Lord has come to pass against us ˹all˺: we will certainly taste ˹the punishment˺
verses.37:32: We caused you to deviate, for we ourselves were deviant.”
verses.37:33: Surely on that Day they will ˹all˺ share in the punishment
verses.37:34: That is certainly how We deal with the wicked
verses.37:35: For whenever it was said to them ˹in the world˺, “There is no god ˹worthy of worship˺ except Allah,” they acted arrogantly
verses.37:36: and argued, “Should we really abandon our gods for a mad poet?”
verses.37:37: In fact, he came with the truth, confirming ˹earlier˺ messengers
verses.37:38: You will certainly taste the painful torment
verses.37:39: and will only be rewarded for what you used to do
verses.37:40: But not the chosen servants of Allah
verses.37:41: They will have a known provision
verses.37:42: fruits ˹of every type˺. And they will be honoured
verses.37:45: A drink ˹of pure wine˺ will be passed around to them from a flowing stream
verses.37:47: It will neither harm ˹them˺, nor will they be intoxicated by it
verses.37:48: And with them will be maidens of modest gaze and gorgeous eyes
verses.37:49: as if they were pristine pearls
verses.37:50: Then they will turn to one another inquisitively
verses.37:51: One of them will say, “I once had a companion ˹in the world˺
verses.37:52: who used to ask ˹me˺, ‘Do you actually believe ˹in resurrection˺
verses.37:53: When we are dead and reduced to dust and bones, will we really be brought to judgment?’”
verses.37:54: He will ˹then˺ ask, “Would you care to see ˹his fate˺?”
verses.37:55: Then he ˹and the others˺ will look and spot him in the midst of the Hellfire
verses.37:56: He will ˹then˺ say, “By Allah! You nearly ruined me
verses.37:57: Had it not been for the grace of my Lord, I ˹too˺ would have certainly been among those brought ˹to Hell˺.”
verses.37:58: ˹Then he will ask his fellow believers,˺ “Can you imagine that we will never die
verses.37:59: except our first death, nor be punished ˹like the others˺?”
verses.37:60: This is truly the ultimate triumph
verses.37:62: Is this ˹bliss˺ a better accommodation or the tree of Zaqqûm
verses.37:63: We have surely made it a test for the wrongdoers
verses.37:64: Indeed, it is a tree that grows in the depths of Hell
verses.37:66: The evildoers will certainly ˹be left to˺ eat from it, filling up their bellies with it
verses.37:67: Then on top of that they will be given a blend of boiling drink
verses.37:68: Then they will ultimately return to ˹their place in˺ Hell
verses.37:69: Indeed, they found their forefathers astray
verses.37:70: so they rushed in their footsteps
verses.37:71: And surely most of the earlier generations had strayed before them
verses.37:72: although We had certainly sent warners among them
verses.37:73: See then what was the end of those who had been warned
verses.37:74: But not the chosen servants of Allah
verses.37:75: Indeed, Noah cried out to Us, and how excellent are We in responding
verses.37:76: We delivered him and his family from the great distress
verses.37:77: and made his descendants the sole survivors
verses.37:78: And We blessed him ˹with honourable mention˺ among later generations
verses.37:79: “Peace be upon Noah among all peoples.”
verses.37:80: Indeed, this is how We reward the good-doers
verses.37:81: ˹For˺ he was truly one of Our faithful servants
verses.37:83: And indeed, one of those who followed his way was Abraham
verses.37:84: ˹Remember˺ when he came to his Lord with a pure heart
verses.37:85: and said to his father and his people, “What are you worshipping
verses.37:86: Is it false gods that you desire instead of Allah
verses.37:87: What then do you expect from the Lord of all worlds?”
verses.37:88: He later looked up to the stars ˹in contemplation˺
verses.37:90: So they turned their backs on him and went away
verses.37:91: Then he ˹stealthily˺ advanced towards their gods, and said ˹mockingly˺, “Will you not eat ˹your offerings˺
verses.37:92: What is wrong with you that you cannot speak?”
verses.37:93: Then he swiftly turned on them, striking ˹them˺ with his right hand
verses.37:94: Later, his people came rushing towards him ˹furiously˺
verses.37:95: He argued, “How can you worship what you carve ˹with your own hands˺
verses.37:96: when it is Allah Who created you and whatever you do?”
verses.37:97: They said ˹to one another˺, “Build him a furnace and cast him into the blazing fire.”
verses.37:98: And so they sought to harm him, but We made them inferior
verses.37:99: He later said, “I am leaving ˹in obedience˺ to my Lord. He will guide me
verses.37:100: My Lord! Bless me with righteous offspring.”
verses.37:101: So We gave him good news of a forbearing son
verses.37:102: Then when the boy reached the age to work with him, Abraham said, “O my dear son! I have seen in a dream that I ˹must˺ sacrifice you. So tell me what you think.” He replied, “O my dear father! Do as you are commanded. Allah willing, you will find me steadfast.”
verses.37:103: Then when they submitted ˹to Allah’s Will˺, and Abraham laid him on the side of his forehead ˹for sacrifice˺
verses.37:104: We called out to him, “O Abraham
verses.37:105: You have already fulfilled the vision.” Indeed, this is how We reward the good-doers
verses.37:106: That was truly a revealing test
verses.37:107: And We ransomed his son with a great sacrifice
verses.37:108: and blessed Abraham ˹with honourable mention˺ among later generations
verses.37:110: This is how We reward the good-doers
verses.37:111: He was truly one of Our faithful servants
verses.37:112: We ˹later˺ gave him good news of Isaac—a prophet, and one of the righteous
verses.37:113: We blessed him and Isaac as well. Some of their descendants did good, while others clearly wronged themselves
verses.37:114: And We certainly showed favour to Moses and Aaron
verses.37:115: and delivered them and their people from the great distress
verses.37:116: We helped them so it was they who prevailed
verses.37:117: We gave them the clear Scripture
verses.37:118: and guided them to the Straight Path
verses.37:119: And We blessed them ˹with honourable mention˺ among later generations
verses.37:121: Indeed, this is how We reward the good-doers
verses.37:122: They were truly ˹two˺ of Our faithful servants
verses.37:123: And Elias was indeed one of the messengers
verses.37:124: ˹Remember˺ when he said to his people, “Will you not fear ˹Allah˺
verses.37:125: Do you call upon ˹the idol of˺ Ba’l and abandon the Best of Creators—
verses.37:126: Allah, your Lord and the Lord of your forefathers?”
verses.37:127: But they rejected him, so they will certainly be brought ˹for punishment˺
verses.37:128: But not the chosen servants of Allah
verses.37:129: We blessed him ˹with honourable mention˺ among later generations
verses.37:131: Indeed, this is how We reward the good-doers
verses.37:132: He was truly one of Our faithful servants
verses.37:133: And Lot was indeed one of the messengers
verses.37:134: ˹Remember˺ when We delivered him and all of his family
verses.37:135: except an old woman, who was one of the doomed
verses.37:137: You ˹Meccans˺ certainly pass by their ruins day
verses.37:138: and night. Will you not then understand
verses.37:139: And Jonah was indeed one of the messengers
verses.37:140: ˹Remember˺ when he fled to the overloaded ship
verses.37:141: Then ˹to save it from sinking,˺ he drew straws ˹with other passengers˺. He lost ˹and was thrown overboard˺
verses.37:142: Then the whale engulfed him while he was blameworthy
verses.37:144: he would have certainly remained in its belly until the Day of Resurrection
verses.37:145: But We cast him onto the open ˹shore˺, ˹totally˺ worn out
verses.37:146: and caused a squash plant to grow over him
verses.37:147: We ˹later˺ sent him ˹back˺ to ˹his city of˺ at least one hundred thousand people
verses.37:148: who then believed ˹in him˺, so We allowed them enjoyment for a while
verses.37:149: Ask them ˹O Prophet˺ if your Lord has daughters, while the pagans ˹prefer to˺ have sons
verses.37:150: Or ˹ask them˺ if We created the angels as females right before their eyes
verses.37:151: Indeed, it is one of their ˹outrageous˺ fabrications to say
verses.37:152: “Allah has children.” They are simply liars
verses.37:153: Has He chosen daughters over sons
verses.37:154: What is the matter with you? How do you judge
verses.37:155: Will you not then be mindful
verses.37:156: Or do you have ˹any˺ compelling proof
verses.37:157: Then bring ˹us˺ your scripture, if what you say is true
verses.37:158: They have also established a ˹marital˺ relationship between Him and the jinn. Yet the jinn ˹themselves˺ know well that such people will certainly be brought ˹for punishment˺
verses.37:159: Glorified is Allah far above what they claim
verses.37:160: But not the chosen servants of Allah
verses.37:161: Surely you ˹pagans˺ and whatever ˹idols˺ you worship
verses.37:162: can never lure ˹anyone˺ away from Him
verses.37:163: except those ˹destined˺ to burn in Hell
verses.37:164: ˹The angels respond,˺ “There is not one of us without an assigned station ˹of worship˺
verses.37:165: We are indeed the ones lined up in ranks ˹for Allah˺
verses.37:166: And we are indeed the ones ˹constantly˺ glorifying ˹His praise˺.”
verses.37:168: “If only we had a Reminder like ˹those of˺ earlier peoples
verses.37:169: we would have truly been Allah’s devoted servants.”
verses.37:170: But ˹now˺ they reject it, so they will soon know
verses.37:171: Our Word has already gone forth to Our servants, the messengers
verses.37:172: that they would surely be helped
verses.37:173: and that Our forces will certainly prevail
verses.37:174: So turn away from the deniers for a while ˹O Prophet˺
verses.37:175: You will see ˹what will happen to˺ them, and they too will see
verses.37:176: Do they ˹really˺ wish to hasten Our punishment
verses.37:177: Yet when it descends upon them: how evil will that morning be for those who had been warned
verses.37:178: And turn away from them for a while
verses.37:179: You will see, and they too will see
verses.37:180: Glorified is your Lord—the Lord of Honour and Power—above what they claim
verses.37:182: And praise be to Allah—Lord of all worlds
